An '''electroblade training sword''', sometimes referred to as a '''practice saber''',<ref name="attack">{{TORcite|type=class|[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]|Attack of the Flesh Raiders|[[Tython/Legends|Tython]]}}</ref> was a melee training weapon used by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Similar to [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibroswords]], electroblade swords were melee weapons with cylindrical blades that delivered painful shocks on contact instead of cutting or cauterizing like a normal sword or [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]].<ref name="Jedi Weapons" /><ref name="Sith Weapons" />

[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] would use electroblade training swords until they were deemed worthy of journeying to the [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] [[Vur Tepe|Forge]] and creating their own lightsaber.<ref name="Jedi Weapons" /> Similarly, [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolytes]] were required to wield these in order to earn the right to use [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith sword|warblades]], which in turn would earn them the right to wield a lightsaber.<ref name="Sith Weapons" />

The electroblade was widely used as a combat melee weapon by both the Imperial and Republic Armies, as well as by paramilitary groups.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Electroblade training swords first appeared in ''[[The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 1: Shades of the Sith]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] in [[2010]] which served as a prequel to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]] where they were first identified and featured prominently. In game, they are used by [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] classes on their starting [[Planet/Legends|planets]] until they obtain better equipment; they were first named in the Codex entries for "Jedi Weapons" and "Sith Weapons."<ref name="Jedi Weapons" /><ref name="Sith Weapons" />
